article_title: US interest rates held as Fed boss says 'no magic wand' to tackle high prices

tasks.prompt: What is the central issue in the article?
options: The Fed cut rates sharply after inflation disappeared
The US government replaced the Federal Reserve
The Fed held rates steady despite persistent inflation and disagreement over whether to raise them
All Fed policymakers agreed that high prices were no longer a problem
tasks.correct_answer: The Fed held rates steady despite persistent inflation and disagreement over whether to raise them
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בהחלטה להשאיר את הריבית ללא שינוי מול אינפלציה גבוהה ומחלוקת פנימית, כאשר שלושה חברים תמכו בהעלאה.

tasks.prompt: How did the Fed's policymakers vote on the interest-rate decision?
options: Nine voted to hold rates and three preferred an increase
All twelve voted to cut rates
Six voted to hold and six voted to abolish the target
Three voted to hold and nine preferred a decrease
tasks.correct_answer: Nine voted to hold rates and three preferred an increase
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההחלטה התקבלה ברוב של 9 מול 3; שלושת המתנגדים ביקשו להעלות את הריבית כדי להילחם במחירים הגבוהים.

tasks.prompt: Which combination does the article identify as adding to inflation pressure?
options: Falling oil prices, lower tariffs and weak technology spending
Cheaper electricity and declining demand for computer chips
A housing subsidy and a stronger dollar only
Higher energy prices linked to the Iran war, tariffs, and heavy AI-related spending
tasks.correct_answer: Higher energy prices linked to the Iran war, tariffs, and heavy AI-related spending
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מצביעה על מחירי אנרגיה בעקבות המלחמה באיראן, מכסים והשקעות AI שמעלות ביקוש ועלויות כגון שבבים וחשמל.

tasks.prompt: What does a “rate hike” mean in the article?
options: A sudden fall in consumer prices
An increase in the central bank's interest rate
A rise in wages set by private companies
A reduction in the cost of mortgages
tasks.correct_answer: An increase in the central bank's interest rate
tasks.explanation_hebrew: rate hike היא העלאת ריבית על ידי הבנק המרכזי, צעד שמייקר בדרך כלל אשראי ויכול לצמצם ביקוש.

tasks.prompt: Warsh said he wanted to “disabuse” people of the magic-wand idea. What does “disabuse” mean here?
options: Encourage people to believe a convenient story
Delay publishing the interest-rate vote
Correct someone's mistaken belief
Promise that prices will fall within days
tasks.explanation_hebrew: disabuse פירושו להעמיד אדם על טעותו; וורש רצה להבהיר שאין פתרון קסם ומהיר לאינפלציה.

tasks.prompt: What does “elevated inflation” mean in this report?
options: Inflation that cannot be measured
Inflation that has already reached zero
A temporary rise in share prices
Inflation that remains higher than the desired level
tasks.correct_answer: Inflation that remains higher than the desired level
tasks.explanation_hebrew: elevated מתאר רמה גבוהה מהרגיל או מהרצוי; כאן האינפלציה נותרה מעל יעד ה־2% של הבנק.

tasks.prompt: Why might three policymakers prefer a rate increase even though the majority held rates steady? Answer in 3–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין אינפלציה מתמשכת, יעד ה־2%, לחצי המחירים והרעיון שריבית גבוהה יותר עשויה לצמצם ביקוש.
expected_points: Inflation has remained above the Fed's 2% target
Energy, tariffs or other pressures could keep prices high
Higher rates can reduce borrowing and demand
The dissents signal concern that current policy may not be restrictive enough

tasks.prompt: Write an 80–120 word summary of the article without copying sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את החלטת הריבית, תוצאת ההצבעה, גורמי האינפלציה והסברו של וורש שאין פתרון מהיר.
expected_points: The Fed kept its benchmark rate unchanged for a fifth meeting
The vote was 9–3, with three members preferring a rise
Inflation remains above target amid energy, tariff and other pressures
Warsh promised action but rejected the idea of a quick fix
The decision affects borrowers, households and savers

tasks.prompt: Explain the meaning of Warsh's “no magic wand” comment in 4–5 sentences and connect it to the Fed's decision.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לפרש את המטפורה כשלילת פתרון מיידי ולהסביר שמדיניות ריבית משפיעה בהדרגה ובתנאי אי־ודאות.
expected_points: A magic wand represents an instant and effortless solution
Warsh says inflation cannot be returned to target in days or weeks
Interest-rate policy works with delays and trade-offs
Holding rates reflects caution while the Fed watches inflation and the economy

tasks.prompt: Compare one likely effect of unchanged rates on borrowers with one likely effect on savers. Write 4–6 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג השפעה סבירה על עלות הלוואות או משכנתאות והשפעה על תשואות החיסכון, תוך הימנעות מטענה שכל הריביות זהות.
expected_points: Borrowing and mortgage costs may remain relatively high
Households with loans may continue to face pressure
Savers may continue receiving relatively stronger returns
Retail rates do not always move exactly with the benchmark rate
